d.title: Lupin III: Fuuma Ichizoku no Inbou
d.jp: ルパン三世　風魔一族の陰謀
syn: Rupan Sansei: Fuma Ichizoku no Imboo
Lupin III: The Plot of the Fuma Clan
d.synopsis: Goemon's wedding to Murasaki Inabe, daughter of a samurai clan's leader, is interrupted when the Fuma ninjas attack, kidnapping the bride-to-be and demanding her family's ancient treasure as ransom. Lupin, Jigen, Goemon and Fujiko work together once again to try to save Murasaki and get to the treasure before the Fuma can steal it.
